chunks: Al-ʿAlāʾ narrated from Muḥammad ibn Muslim, from one of the two Imams, peace be upon them, who said:
The divorced woman may perform hajj during her waiting period ('iddah).
ai.seo_question: May a divorced woman perform hajj during her 'iddah?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling that a divorced woman may perform hajj while she is still in her waiting period ('iddah). It addresses an issue of worship within the framework of family law and clarifies permissibility in this circumstance.

en.bab-ul-qaim-publications: Hadith.2913 - Al-'Ala' narrated from Muhammad ibn Muslim, from one of the Imams (as), who said:
"A divorced woman may perform Hajj during her waiting period ('iddah)."
